description: Use when the user asks whether a US airport has delays, a ground stop or a closure right now. Live from the FAA. Give the airport code (e.g. SFO) or leave it out for all current delays.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

name: airport_delays
title: US airport delays and ground stops (FAA)
